title: Director of Parks and Recreation
description: The Director of Parks and Recreation provides strategic leadership, administrative direction, and oversight of all activities of the Parks and Recreation Department (excluding Golf and Library), including, but not limited to city parks, special events, recreation programs and facilities, public art initiatives, trails, park operations and maintenance, facility operations and maintenance, capital, projects, and all relevant items pertaining to the department. This position develops, implements, and enforces policies, programs, and initiatives that enhance quality of life and promote community well-being. The Director enforces and sets expectations and standards of excellence, collaborating with department leadership to ensure quality and performance align accordingly. This position requires strong leadership, creativity, and independent judgement.
